svg.title: The setup wizard in a terminal: the last Google Cloud step, saving the key file, the sign-in, the Ready check and the Claude Code command (example output, made-up email)
svg.text: Step 5 of 5: Create and download the key file (OAuth client)
What: This small file tells Google which program asks for your sign-in. It stays on your computer.
Do: Click Create client. Application type: Desktop app. Name: gchat-mcp. Click Create, then Download JSON.
Done when: A file named client_secret_....json is in your Downloads folder.
Key file: saved to ~/.config/gchat-mcp/client_secret.json (only you can read it).
Sign-in: a Google page opens in your browser. Choose your work account and click Allow.
If Google says the app is not verified, click Continue: it is your own app.
Ready: signed in as you@yourcompany.com; 37 conversations found.
Last step: add the server to your AI assistant.
claude mcp add -s user gchat -- uvx --python 3.13 google-chat-mcp
